description: This file declares the 'Shutdown' class, which is a task related to shutting down a generic GST player within the Rialto media server component. It includes class declaration, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, and references external interfaces and the GStreamer library.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A task class responsible for handling shutdown procedures for a generic GST player within the Rialto media server.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown task with a reference to the IGstGenericPlayerPrivate interface.
